tools.name: test_robots
tools.description: Test one URL against a site's robots.txt for 20+ crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot and more) using correct longest-match rules. Returns allowed/blocked per bot with the deciding rule.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Extract JSON-LD and microdata from a page, validate Organization, WebSite, Product, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, LocalBusiness and SoftwareApplication, and return a corrected JSON-LD block.

tools.name: check_rendering
tools.description: Estimate whether a page's content exists in the raw HTML before JavaScript runs (heuristic, no headless browser). Most AI crawlers do not execute JavaScript.

tools.name: preview_meta
tools.description: Read title, meta description, canonical, robots, Open Graph and Twitter tags with lengths, and return data for Google, LinkedIn, X and WhatsApp previews.

tools.name: check_redirects
tools.description: Trace the redirect chain for a URL (max 10 hops) with status and timing per hop, plus X-Robots-Tag, HSTS, cache-control, content-type and canonical Link headers.

tools.name: validate_sitemap
tools.description: Find and validate a domain's sitemaps, count URLs, status-check a sample of up to 50 URLs and check hreflang reciprocity.

tools.name: score_citability
tools.description: Score each passage of a page for how easily AI answer engines can quote it. Deterministic heuristics, no LLM.

tools.name: generate_og_image
tools.description: Resolve title, description and favicon for a 1200x630 Open Graph card from a URL or from text. Returns card data; render the PNG at the report_url.

tools.name: check_page_speed
tools.description: Google PageSpeed Insights for a URL: mobile and desktop Lighthouse scores, Core Web Vitals, CrUX field data when available, top opportunities.

tools.name: check_common_crawl
tools.description: Check whether a domain appears in the latest Common Crawl crawls (a major source of LLM training data) and whether robots.txt blocks CCBot.

tools.name: check_entity
tools.description: Look up a brand on Wikidata and Wikipedia, report key properties, and check the site's Organization sameAs links.

tools.name: submit_indexnow
tools.description: Verify an IndexNow key file on a domain and, only if it verifies, submit up to 100 URLs to api.indexnow.org. Set action to "submit" to send URLs; the default only verifies.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Request a page as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and other AI crawlers and compare with a normal browser to find robots.txt or CDN blocks.

tools.name: view_as_crawler
tools.description: Show the text and structure an AI crawler recovers from a page without running JavaScript.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Generate an llms.txt file for a domain from its sitemap (up to 40 pages in this MCP call).

tools.name: run_free_audit
tools.description: Free AI readiness audit: crawlability, headings, structured data, llms.txt and metadata, scored 0 to 100.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "free" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_rendering, check_redirects, validate_sitemap, generate_og_image, check_page_speed · Private data: submit_indexnow, generate_llms_txt · Public sink: submit_indexnow · Destructive: check_rendering, run_free_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_rendering, check_redirects, validate_sitemap, generate_og_image, check_page_speed · Private data: submit_indexnow, generate_llms_txt · Public sink: submit_indexnow · Destructive: check_rendering, run_free_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
